description: Octave effect in the style of the Pearl OC-7 and Boss OC-2 pedals, mixing the input with one octave up, one octave down and two octaves down

params.text: Sets how much of the octave above goes into the mix, 0% to 100%; that octave comes from rectifying the input and doubling it, which suits sine and triangle waves
Sets how much of the unaltered input goes into the mix, 0% to 100%
Sets how much of the octave below goes into the mix, 0% to 100%
Sets how much of the two octaves below goes into the mix, 0% to 100%
Sets the gain applied to the finished mix, 0 to 5 with unity at 1, pushing the tanh limiter into saturation as it rises
Inverts and attenuates the CV for that mix amount, -100% to 100%; the sum of CV and knob is clamped between 0% and 100%
Inverts and attenuates the drive CV, -100% to 100%; the sum of CV and knob is clamped between 0 and 10
Chooses how the sub-octaves are generated, by the Pearl inversion method or the Boss square method, each with its own sound
Sets oversampling to x2, x4 or x8; x2 covers almost everything, with the higher rates for very high frequency material

inputs.text: Modulates that mix amount at 10% per volt, summed with the knob above it
Modulates the drive by 1 per volt, summed with the DRIVE knob
The signal to be octave shifted, AC coupled on the way in; feed it one pitch per polyphonic channel, and its channel count sets the output channel count

outputs.text: The finished mix, limited to +/-6V by a saturating tanh function
